meta.title: Tour Routes — Whizzzest
meta.description: Three suggested Wanzai itineraries covering the old town, mountain and river scenery, and local revolutionary history.

routes.name: Ancient City Cultural Tour
routes.description: Start in Wanzai Ancient City, try local dishes for lunch and make time for Xiabu weaving or Desheng Drum music. End the day with fireworks if a show is scheduled.
routes.alt: Aerial view of the tiled rooftops of Wanzai Ancient City

stops.name: Wanzai Ancient City
stops.desc: Visit the ancestral halls and local history museum.

stops.name: Xiabu weaving experience
stops.desc: Learn how ramie cloth is woven. Check whether a demonstration or workshop is available.

stops.name: Wanzai Ancient City fireworks
stops.desc: Check the evening schedule before heading to the viewing area.

routes.name: Mountains, Caves and Rivers
routes.description: Visit Zhushan Cave and Henghui Art Agriculture Park in the morning. After lunch, explore Jiulong Forest Park or look for an evening event at Longhu Park.
routes.alt: Paths and buildings around the lake in Longhu Park

stops.name: Henghui Art Agriculture Park
stops.desc: Walk through the landscaped farm park.

stops.name: Jiulong Forest Park
stops.desc: Explore the forest and check whether rafting is operating.

stops.name: Longhu Park
stops.desc: Walk by the lake or watch a display if one is scheduled.

routes.name: Revolutionary History Tour
routes.description: Start at the memorial halls and follow the local revolutionary history trail in Xianyuan. If available, try a meal inspired by the Red Army period. Return to Wanzai Ancient City in the evening.
routes.alt: A group gathers in front of a memorial in Xianyuan

stops.name: Hunan-Hubei-Jiangxi Revolutionary Memorial Hall
stops.desc: Learn about the revolutionary base that spanned Hunan, Hubei and Jiangxi.

stops.name: Martyrs' Memorial Hall
stops.desc: Visit the memorial to those who died in the conflict.

stops.name: Xianyuan revolutionary base sites
stops.desc: Follow the trail through the former revolutionary base.

stops.name: Wanzai Ancient City
stops.desc: Check what heritage performances or fireworks are scheduled.
